<function name="SetMaxVisionRange" parent="NextBot" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets the maximum range the nextbot can see other nextbots/players at. See <page>NextBot:IsAbleToSee</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2020.08.12</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="range" type="number">The new vision range to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
